The first subplot, titled "Easy Training Set," displays a line plot illustrating "Training Rewards" over the number of "Steps" taken during training for two scenarios or models, named "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LOCE-Easy." The x-axis, labeled "Steps," indicates the progression of training over time, with values ranging approximately from 0 to 500. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," measures the reward received during training, with values spanning from 0 to 0.4. Two lines are present: the line for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" starts from a lower value and gradually increases, showing a slight decline before leveling off towards 0.4; the "Llama-LOCE-Easy" line begins slightly higher, has a steadier increase and then a slight upward trend before stabilizing close to 0.4. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line is colored blue, while the "Llama-LOCE-Easy" line is red. Both lines use a solid line style.

The second subplot, titled "Hard Training Set," depicts a similar line plot but for a "Hard Training Set." The x-axis remains labeled "Steps," showing the same scale as the first plot, while the y-axis continues to track "Training Rewards" with the same scale, albeit slightly lower, extending from 0 to 0.2 to accommodate the increase in rewards. Here too, two lines represent the two models being compared. The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line starts at a lower reward than the other, increases steadily to around 0.2, and then shows minor ups and downs with a general upward trend. The "Llama-LOCE-Hard" line begins higher than its counterpart in the easy set but follows a similar pattern, mostly ascending slightly initially, and then fluctuating up and down, reaching just above 0.2 by the end of 500 steps. These lines are also solid in style, with the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line in blue and the "Llama-LOCE-Hard" line in red.
